title: Amazon rainforest wildfires
story: During the 2019 dry season, satellites tracked persistent fires along roads in the Brazilian Amazon. Smoke from fires across the region contributed to dark daytime skies in São Paulo.

title: Black Summer bushfires
story: Fires in New South Wales and Victoria produced vast smoke plumes. In early January, intense fires generated towering clouds that carried smoke high into the atmosphere.

title: Siberian taiga wildfires
story: As the summer progressed, fires spread across the forests of Sakha and smoke blanketed large parts of northeastern Siberia.

title: Canada’s historic wildfire season
story: Canada’s 2023 season broke national records. This view focuses on Québec, where a lightning-ignited fire on June 1 grew rapidly later that summer.

title: Palisades and Eaton fires
story: Palisades and Eaton ignited on the same day. Strong Santa Ana winds drove flames from dry hills into Pacific Palisades and Altadena.
